entries.title: DRAFT: Conditional cumulant-to-vertex bounds
entries.statement: DRAFT concept material, not a full P0321 proof. Fix q,a>0 and D,B>=0. If real X_{L,r}, 2<=r<=L/4, has E exp(q|X|)<infinity, |kappa_2(X)-a log r|<=D and sum_{n>=3}q^n|kappa_n(X)|/n!<=B uniformly in L,r, then with eta=q^2 a/2 and H=q^2 D/2+B, exp(-H)r^(-eta)<=|E exp(iqX)|<=exp(H)r^(-eta). Final snapshot and model/account admission review remain pending.
assumptions: Real random variables with the stated exponential integrability
Cumulants are Taylor coefficients of the local logarithm of the moment-generating function
Uniform variance and absolute higher-cumulant bounds

entries.title: DRAFT: Connected scale cumulants without independence
entries.statement: DRAFT concept material, not a full P0321 proof. For X=sum_{j=0}^J Z_j with E exp(q sum_j|Z_j|)<infinity, if b_n,y_j,Y are all nonnegative and sum_{j_2,...,j_n}|cum(Z_j,Z_{j_2},...,Z_{j_n})|<=n! b_n y_j for every n>=3,j, sum_j y_j<=Y and sum_{n>=3}q^n b_n<infinity uniformly, then sum_{n>=3}q^n|kappa_n(X)|/n!<=Y sum_{n>=3}q^n b_n. Independence is unnecessary. Final snapshot and model/account admission review remain pending.
assumptions: Finite sum and stated joint exponential moments
Absolute anchored connected-cumulant and summability bounds
All bound coefficients b_n, activity weights y_j, and the total bound Y are nonnegative, including zero-weight cases.

entries.title: DRAFT: Transfer to a microscopic bond observable with explicit limit order
entries.statement: DRAFT concept material, not a full P0321 proof. Assume L1 with q=6, and C_{6,L}(r)=A_{L,r}E exp(i6X_{L,r})+epsilon_{L,r}, with 0<A_-<=|A|<=A_+, |epsilon|<=E_0 r^(-eta-delta), delta>0 uniformly. For r>=max(2,(2E_0 exp(H)/A_-)^(1/delta)) and r<=L/4, (A_- exp(-H)/2)r^(-eta)<=|C_{6,L}(r)|<=(A_+ exp(H)+E_0)r^(-eta). The bounds pass to any existing fixed-r thermodynamic limit. Alternatively, retain L1 and the amplitude bounds, assume epsilon_{L,r}->0 at every fixed r and existence of the fixed-r limit of C_{6,L}; taking L->infinity before r->infinity yields A_- exp(-H)r^(-eta)<=|C_6(r)|<=A_+ exp(H)r^(-eta). No joint distance/volume rate is asserted by this alternative. Final snapshot and model/account admission review remain pending.
assumptions: A correlation limit must exist to assert an infinite-state bound
Either the original uniform scale-decaying error or the stated fixed-r vanishing-error alternative; limit order is explicit.

entries.title: DRAFT: Logarithmic variance can have zero vertex correlation
entries.statement: DRAFT concept material, not a full P0321 proof. For any q>0 and independent fair signs epsilon_j, X_J=(pi/(2q))sum_{j=1}^J epsilon_j has variance (pi/(2q))^2 log(r)/log(2) at r=2^J, but E exp(iqX_J)=0 for every J>=1. Logarithmic variance alone cannot imply positive algebraic vertex bounds. Final snapshot and model/account admission review remain pending.
assumptions: Independent fair signs only in this constructed counterexample

entries.remaining_gap: Refutes only variance-only correlation transfer; it is not a Riesz process counterexample.

entries.title: DRAFT: Positive wrapped-Gaussian perturbation cancels the leading vertex
entries.statement: DRAFT concept material, not a full P0321 proof. Let a=r^(-eta)<=1/4, eta>0. The wrapped centered Gaussian of variance 2eta log r has density p=(1+2sum_{n>=1}a^(n^2)cos(nphi))/(2pi) and first vertex coefficient a. The positive density q=p-a cos(phi)/pi has zero first vertex coefficient and d_TV(P,Q)=2a/pi, using d_TV=sup_A|P(A)-Q(A)|. Thus even O(r^(-eta)) approximation error can erase the full algebraic correlation; o(r^(-eta)) controls it by |E_P f-E_Q f|<=2d_TV for |f|<=1. Final snapshot and model/account admission review remain pending.
assumptions: No assertion that the pair laws form a stationary microscopic field

relations.rationale: L3 begins 'Assume L1 with q=6'; L1 supplies exp(-H)r^(-eta)<=|E exp(iqX)|<=exp(H)r^(-eta), the exact leading bounds used by the two triangle inequalities.
L2 supplies sum_{n>=3}q^n|kappa_n(X)|/n!<=Y sum q^n b_n. L1 requires this same higher-cumulant bound plus a separate logarithmic variance estimate; L2 does not prove the missing variance input.
C1 has exact logarithmic variance but E exp(iqX)=0. L1 has a positive lower bound only under absolute all-order cumulant summability, which C1 cannot satisfy at that q.

C2 cancels a wrapped-Gaussian correlation a=r^(-eta) at TV distance 2a/pi. L3 requires an insertion error below the leading correlation scale, or an error that disappears in the fixed-r limit; C2 has neither guarantee.

The existing card asks for an intermediate hexatic phase with orientational order and absent crystalline positional order. M is the explicitly unproved microscopic defect/insertion and positional-disorder input needed by this conditional angular route.
